trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Initiates interaction, states lead ID and goal.
steps.text: Hello, நான் உங்க 2BHK listing பார்த்தேன். இந்த weekend site visit வரலாமா? என் lead id LD-1001.
steps.clean_text: Hello, நான் உங்க 2BHK listing பார்த்தேன். இந்த weekend site visit வரலாமா? என் lead id LD-1001.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, நான் உங்க 2BHK listing பார்த்தேன். இந்த weekend site visit வரலாமா? என் lead id LD-1001.

steps.purpose: Retrieve lead details based on the provided ID.
Returns lead budget and configuration preferences.
Acknowledge lead details and inform the user about checking inventory.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the lead's budget and configuration without making unverified promises.
steps.text: Thank you. உங்க budget 90 lakhs குள்ள இருக்கு, and நீங்க 2BHK தேடுறீங்க. 'Oasis' project-ல units available இருக்கு. நான் check பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: Validates the user's intent and bridges to the inventory check.

steps.purpose: Check available inventory for the requested configuration.
Return available units and project details including RERA ID.
Present the available unit, price, possession, and RERA ID.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact price, possession quarter, and RERA ID from the tool result, trailing off to allow a barge-in.
steps.text: Oasis project-ல 5th floor-ல ஒரு 2BHK இருக்கு. Carpet area 750 sqft. இதோட price 85 lakhs. Possession Q4 2025-ல வரும். And இதோட RERA ID P52100012345. நீங்க...
steps.planner_rationale: Complies with BR_RE_01, BR_RE_02, and BR_RE_03 by accurately presenting tool data.

steps.purpose: Interrupt the agent to challenge the quoted price.
steps.text: Wait, 85 lakhs-ஆ? அது எப்படி அவ்ளோ அதிகம் ஆச்சு? Listing-ல அது கம்மியா இருந்ததே.
steps.clean_text: Wait, 85 lakhs-ஆ? அது எப்படி அவ்ளோ அதிகம் ஆச்சு? Listing-ல அது கம்மியா இருந்ததே.
steps.model_visible_text: Wait, 85 lakhs-ஆ? அது எப்படி அவ்ளோ அதிகம் ஆச்சு? Listing-ல அது கம்மியா இருந்ததே.

steps.purpose: Recover from barge-in and substantiate the price using exact tool data.
steps.expected_behavior: Address the interruption directly by explaining the source of the price without repeating the RERA ID or possession details.
steps.text: நான் system-ல இருக்கிற current inventory price தான் சொல்றேன். U-501 unit-ஓட exact price 8500000. இது தான் இப்போ available ஆன price.
steps.planner_rationale: Demonstrates barge-in recovery and tool grounding by citing the exact tool result for the price.

steps.purpose: Ask for investment advice regarding the property.
steps.text: Okay, புரியுது. ஆனா இந்த property நல்ல investment-ஆ? Future-ல price ஏறுமா?
steps.clean_text: Okay, புரியுது. ஆனா இந்த property நல்ல investment-ஆ? Future-ல price ஏறுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: Okay, புரியுது. ஆனா இந்த property நல்ல investment-ஆ? Future-ல price ஏறுமா?

steps.purpose: Refuse to give investment advice per business rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely decline to predict price appreciation or offer investment advice.
steps.text: என்னால future price appreciation பத்தி predict பண்ண முடியாது. System-ல இருக்கிற details வச்சு நான் price and possession மட்டும் தான் confirm பண்ண முடியும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Enforces BR_RE_04 by strictly avoiding any investment predictions.

steps.purpose: Accept the limitation and request to schedule a site visit.
steps.text: சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் side visit போக ready. Sunday morning போலாமா?
steps.clean_text: சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் site visit போக ready. Sunday morning போலாமா?
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் side visit போக ready. Sunday morning போலாமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the site visit booking with the user.
steps.expected_behavior: State the visit reference and executive name exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: உங்க visit schedule ஆயிடுச்சு. Sunday morning நீங்க Oasis project பாக்கலாம். உங்க executive name Rahul, and உங்க visit reference VIS-992.
steps.planner_rationale: Confirms the successful terminal condition by grounding the response in the scheduling tool output.

steps.purpose: Ask for a forward guarantee regarding the executive's call.
Refuse to guarantee an exact call time since the tool did not provide one.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to state an exact time for the executive's call, strictly adhering to what the tool returned.
steps.text: என்னோட system-ல visit reference VIS-992 and executive Rahul னு மட்டும் தான் update ஆயிருக்கு. அவர் எப்போ call பண்ணுவாரு னு exact time என்னால சொல்ல முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: Demonstrates strict tool output grounding by not inventing a forward guarantee about the executive's actions.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
